$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the RBAC module catalogue. Read by BOTH the PHP resolver (application/helpers/rbac_helper.php → RBAC_MODULES) and the staffCapabilities Cloud Function (functions/staffCapabilities.js). Lives under functions/ so the Firebase Functions deploy bundles it. Editing this list updates both systems at once — this replaces the two hand-maintained copies that silently drifted (Device Management / Message Monitor were added to PHP but not the CF, so demoted admins lost app-side access). Keep ordering stable; keep names byte-exact (incl. spaces, e.g. 'Red Flags').
